description: This file defines the SuiteValidator class within the SuiteCRM\'Utility\' namespace. It provides methods for validating IDs, keys, and percentage fields, and includes logic for pattern retrieval based on configuration settings.

classes.name: SuiteValidator
classes.description: A utility class for validating IDs, keys, and percentage fields within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: isValidId
methods.description: Validates whether the provided ID is either numeric or matches the ID validation pattern.

methods.name: isValidKey
methods.description: Validates whether the provided key is either numeric or matches the key validation pattern.

methods.name: isPercentageField
methods.description: Determines if a given field name is a percentage-related field based on specific string patterns.

methods.name: getIdValidationPattern
methods.description: Retrieves the regex pattern used for ID validation, based on configuration settings.

methods.name: getKeyValidationPattern
methods.description: Retrieves the regex pattern used for key validation, based on configuration settings.
